releases.title: Company name under Marvin
releases.summary: The same sidebar is on every page. A licensed machine shows the company name under Marvin. A chevron beside Marvin folds the rail.

changes.title: The company name under Marvin
changes.description: When this box has a valid Enterprise license, the gold company badge sits under Marvin, on the left. Machines without a license stay just Marvin.

changes.title: A chevron beside Marvin
changes.description: The arrow to the right of Marvin folds the sidebar to icons. This browser still remembers.

releases.title: One sidebar, and Back from a project
releases.summary: The same sidebar is on every page. Opening a project changes the address, so Back returns you to the list.

changes.title: The same sidebar everywhere
changes.description: Projects, the room, setup, and Settings use one rail: Marvin, Projects, Settings, and your name.

changes.title: A project is a page
changes.description: Opening a project changes the address. The browser Back button, or Projects in the rail, returns you to the list.

changes.title: Collapse the sidebar
changes.description: Fold the rail down to icons when you want more room. This browser remembers.

releases.title: Enterprise mark, and Back from Settings
releases.summary: A licensed machine wears its company name. Settings is a page you can leave with the browser Back button.

changes.title: The company name on the machine
changes.description: When this box has a valid Enterprise license, Marvin shows a gold badge with the company name on the rail.

changes.title: Leave Settings like a page
changes.description: Opening Settings changes the address. Use Back in the header, or the browser Back button, to return to projects or the room. Switching sections does not stack extra history.

releases.title: Company sign-in you can follow
releases.summary: Settings is one page at a time, and Sign-in lists the clicks at your identity provider.

changes.title: One settings page at a time
changes.description: The projects rail has Settings. Inside it, pick Sign-in, GitHub, coding agents, sessions, audit, Enterprise, or this machine.

changes.title: Follow the clicks at your provider
changes.description: Choose Entra, Okta, Google, GitHub, or Keycloak. Copy the redirect URL, then paste the issuer, client id, and secret.

changes.title: Try it on this laptop
changes.description: Local test is a fake company login. Sign in as maria (admin) or alex (participant) without a real tenant.

changes.title: Settings during setup
changes.description: An administrator can open settings to connect sign-in or paste a license before the machine is ready.

releases.title: Finish setup before the workspace
releases.summary: A machine stays on a dedicated setup page until GitHub and a coding agent are connected.

changes.title: Required connections first
changes.description: Connect this machine’s GitHub, then pick a coding agent. Nothing else is reachable until both are done.

changes.title: Waiting if you are not an admin
changes.description: Participants see that the machine is not open yet, instead of a locked projects list.

changes.title: Quiet status after setup
changes.description: Once the machine is ready, GitHub and the coding agent sit as compact status next to projects. Your own GitHub stays optional.

changes.title: License on the setup page
changes.description: If you choose a GitHub App before the workspace is open, paste the Enterprise license on that same step.

changes.title: How to make a GitHub token
changes.description: Paste a token now opens the GitHub page and lists which owner, repos, and permissions to pick.

releases.title: A focused workspace
releases.summary: Projects, machine readiness, and updates now live in one calm workspace.

changes.title: Projects come first
changes.description: Open a project from the main workspace while machine setup stays in a compact status rail.

changes.title: One consistent design
changes.description: Sign-in, projects, rooms, and settings now share the same focused visual system.

changes.title: What changed
changes.description: Read plain-language release notes before you update the machine.

changes.title: Live update progress
changes.description: See each update step and the latest install log while the worker restarts.

changes.title: Clear restart status
changes.description: The room tells you when an update is running instead of showing a raw connection error.

releases.title: Company controls
releases.summary: Connect company identity, review signed sessions, and keep audit copies in systems you control.

changes.title: Company sign-in
changes.description: Connect your identity provider and choose which email domains can enter this machine.

changes.title: Session history
changes.description: Review signed session records and choose how long they stay on the machine.

changes.title: Audit delivery
changes.description: Send session records to your own S3 bucket or webhook.

changes.title: GitHub App
changes.description: Connect repositories with a GitHub App while preserving the person who requested each change.
